BURSEVI:v10p253/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p253/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p253/r3.claim: The earth’s provisions benefit people and livestock; grazing extends figuratively to everything consumed from the earth, even salt from water and fire from green wood.
BURSEVI:v10p253/r3.anchor: دل الله تعالى بذكر الماء والمرعي على عامة ما يرتفق به ويتمتع مما يخرج من الأرض حتى الملح فإنه من الماء

BURSEVI:v10p253/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p253/r4.speaker: العتبي
BURSEVI:v10p253/r4.claim: Al-ʿUtbi calls the mention of water and pasture a comprehensive expression for the earth’s food and useful products, including grass, trees, grain, fruit, salt, and fire.
BURSEVI:v10p253/r4.anchor: هذا أي قوله أخرج منها ماءها ومرعاها من جوامع الكلم

BURSEVI:v10p253/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p253/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p253/r5.claim: The mention of worldly provisions rebukes resurrection-deniers by comparing them to cattle that enjoy this life and forget the next.
BURSEVI:v10p253/r5.anchor: ونكتة الاستعارة توبيخ المخاطبين المنكرين للبعث وإلحاقهم بالبهائم في التمتع بالدنيا والذهول عن الآخرة

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p150/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p150/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p150/r2.claim: Re-creation is easy for the One who made the heavens and earth and arranged night, day, and human sustenance; power enables it and wisdom entails it.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p150/r2.anchor: His power bears witness that He can do so and His wisdom entails that He should do so.

BAYDAWI-FULL:79:32-36/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:79:32-36/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:79:32-36/r2.claim: The mountains and land are provision for people and their livestock.
BAYDAWI-FULL:79:32-36/r2.anchor: { متعا لكم ولأنعمكم } تمتيعا لكم ولمواشيكم

NAHHAS:v5p146/r2.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p146/r2.speaker: الفراء
NAHHAS:v5p146/r2.claim: Al-Farrāʾ says the creation is for people's benefit and enjoyment; the word may also be nominative.
NAHHAS:v5p146/r2.anchor: قال الفراء أي خلق ذلك منفعة لكم ومتعة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.claim: The surah’s purpose is to establish resurrection and the gathering, displaying humanity’s final fate after the preceding surahs’ full exposition; its oaths show the matter has reached its decisive climax.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p318/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p318/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p318/r1.claim: Night and day recur as daily demonstrations of resurrection, since restoring life is no harder than creating humanity from nothing.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p318/r1.anchor: ولما كان كل من ذلك يدل على القدرة على البعث لأنه إيجاد ما هو أشد من خلق الآدمي من عدم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p318/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p318/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p318/r6.claim: Humanity and livestock enjoy Earth’s provisions, and the repeated cycle of consuming and restoring what is needed illustrates continual renewal and resurrection.

DURR-FULL:v8p412/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p412/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p412/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses the provision for people as benefit.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r1.claim: The accusative ‘provision’ stands in place of an omitted verb: ‘We provided you with provision.’
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r1.anchor: وانتصب { متاعا } على النيابة عن الفعل . والتقدير : متعناكم متاعا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r2.claim: The lams in ‘for you and your livestock’ reinforce the verbal noun; earth and mountains provide use, shelter from enemies, and safe pasture.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r2.anchor: ولام { لكم ولأنعامكم } لام التقوية لأن المصدر فرع في العمل عن الفعل ،

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r3.claim: Mentioning provision inside the proof embeds gratitude, inviting people to worship their benefactor alone; the wording also uses a blend-then-division figure.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p88/r3.anchor: وهذا إدماج الامتنان في الاستدلال لإثارة شكرهم حق النعمة بأن يعبدوا المنعم وحده

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r1.claim: The phrase means provision for your enjoyment, since bringing forth water and pasture enables people to benefit.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r1.anchor: متاعا لكم أي للإمتاع لأن معنى أخرج منها ماءها ومرعاها أمتع بذلك

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r2.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r2.claim: Matāʿan means a benefit for you.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p23#3/r2.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة متاعا لكم أي منفعة [ لكم ]

JISHUMI:v10p7275/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7275/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7275/r11.claim: The creation of the heavens, earth, mountains, light, and darkness proves resurrection: if God can preserve created substances, He can restore and revive them after their destruction.
JISHUMI:v10p7275/r11.anchor: الآيات تدل على صحة البعث بما بين من خلق السماء، والأرض والجبال، والنور والظلمة

ZAJJAJ:v5p280#2/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p280#2/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p280#2/r4.claim: Matāʿan is accusative as a verbal noun of purpose: God brought out water and pasture for people and their livestock to enjoy.
ZAJJAJ:v5p280#2/r4.anchor: نصب (متاعا لكم) بمعنى قوله أخرج منها ماءها ومرعاها للإمتاع لكم.

STUDYQURAN:79:intro/r8.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:79:intro/r8.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:79:intro/r8.claim: The wonders of creation are presented as evidence that God can resurrect.
STUDYQURAN:79:intro/r8.anchor: cite the wonders of creation as evidence of God’s ability to resurrect

TABATABAI:79:33-41/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:79:33-41/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:79:33-41/r1.claim: The creation and ordering of heaven and Earth provide for humans and their livestock, obligating people to know, fear, and thank their Lord; the greater creation also makes resurrection no difficulty for God.
TABATABAI:79:33-41/r1.anchor: فهذا الخلق والتدبير الذي فيه تمتيعكم يوجب عليكم معرفة ربكم وخوف مقامه وشكر نعمته

SAMIN-DURR:79:33/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:79:33/r1.speaker: العامة
SAMIN-DURR:79:33/r1.claim: The common reading has متاعا accusative, either as a purpose object or as a verbal noun governed by an omitted verb, متعكم.
SAMIN-DURR:79:33/r1.anchor: العامة على النصب مفعولا له، أو مصدرا لعامل مقدر، أي: متعكم

ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r1.claim: The provision for people and animals implies gratitude to God and awareness that He is the Provider, as in the food passage 80:24-32.
ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r1.anchor: Implying (as in 80:24-32) that man ought to be grateful to God, and should always be conscious of His being the Provider

ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r2.claim: This gratitude theme leads into the discourse's return to resurrection and ultimate judgment.
ASAD-NOTES:79:27#n15/r2.anchor: hence the subsequent return of the discourse to the theme of resurrection and ultimate judgment.

ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r1.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r1.claim: One analysis makes mataʿan an object of purpose: God did these things to provide enjoyment for people and their livestock, who benefit from the water and pasture.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r1.anchor: قيل مفعول له أي فعل ذلك تدمتيعا لكم ولأنعامكم

ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r2.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r2.claim: Alternatively it is an emphatic verbal noun for an omitted verb, or a verbal noun with different wording because the preceding actions mean providing enjoyment.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r2.anchor: وقيل مصدر مؤكد لفعله المضمر أي متعكم بذلك متاعا

ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r3.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r3.claim: An objection to the purpose analysis is that the address targets resurrection-deniers whereas the intended beneficiaries are believers; the author replies that direct address is limited to those present but its ruling generalizes to humankind.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r3.anchor: وأجيب بأن خطاب المشافهة وإن كان خاصا بالحاضرين إلا أن حكمه عام

ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r4.claim: Making the word a verbal noun through an implied verb does not remove the objection, since it still introduces a statement of purpose; moreover, the claim that only believers are intended beneficiaries is debatable.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p35/r4.anchor: وأيضا النصب على المصدرية بفعله المقدر لا يدفع المحذور لكونه استئنافا

BINTSHATI:v1p153/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r1.claim: The heavens, earth, water, pasture, and mountains are both signs of God's power and evidence that creating and resurrecting decayed humans is no hardship; they are also divine gifts recalling the heedless, deniers, and arrogant to gratitude.
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r1.anchor: فهي إلى جانب كونها من آيات قدرته تعالى وقوته، شاهدة على أن الذي بناها ورفعها ودحاها

BINTSHATI:v1p153/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r2.claim: The passage moves from proof of the Creator's power to His favor and bounty, paralleling the sequence in Abasa from human creation to food and provision.
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r2.anchor: وسياق الآيات هنا، في الانتقال من الاستدلال بمثل هذا على قدرة الخالق، إلى بيان فضله تعالى ونعمته

BINTSHATI:v1p153/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r3.claim: Both passages follow provision with an abrupt warning of judgment: Abasa turns to the final blast and faces, while al-Naziat turns to the great calamity and reckoning.
BINTSHATI:v1p153/r3.anchor: كذلك يأتي بعد آيات النازعات النذير المباغت، بحساب وجزاء:

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r2.claim: Mentioning pasture suffices for fruits and grain: if God cares for animals, humans deserve care even more; 79:33 signals this ellipsis.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r2.anchor: فالاقتصار على المرعى اكتفاء عن ذكر ما تخرجه الأرض من الثمار والحبوب لأن ذكر المرعى يدل على لطف الله بالعجماوات

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r9.claim: Matāʿ is a benefit enjoyed for a period, with an implication of limited duration; here it denotes granting use for a time, as also explained at 7:24.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p87/r9.anchor: وهو هنا اسم مصدر متع ، أي إعطاء للانتفاع زمانا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r1.claim: Spreading earth brings forth springs, hidden resources, rivers, crops, trees, and fruit, while fixing mountains so the land settles.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r1.anchor: وقوله {متاعا لكم ولأنعامكم} أي: دحا الأرض فأنبع عيونها، وأظهر مكنونها، وأجرى أنهارها، وأنبت زروعها وأشجارها وثمارها، وثبت جبالها، لتستقر بأهلها ويقر قرارها،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r2.claim: These provisions serve people and livestock for eating and riding until their allotted term and lifespan end.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p317/r2.anchor: كل ذلك متاعا لخلقه ولما يحتاجون إليه من الأنعام التي يأكلونها ويركبونها مدة احتياجهم إليها في هذه الدار إلى أن ينتهي الأمد، وينقضي الأجل.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p697#2/r13.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p697#2/r13.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p697#2/r13.claim: God prepared these provisions for the enjoyment of people and their livestock.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p697#2/r13.anchor: { متاعا لكم } فعل ذلك تمتيعا لكم { ولانعامكم } لأن منفعة ذلك التمهيد

MUQATIL:79:27-33/r11.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:79:27-33/r11.speaker: author
MUQATIL:79:27-33/r11.claim: The pasture and other provisions are a livelihood for people and their livestock.
MUQATIL:79:27-33/r11.anchor: متاعا لكم ولأنعامكم } [آية: 33] يقول: معيشة لكم ولمواشيكم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p315#11/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p315#11/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p315#11/r1.claim: God did this to provide enjoyment and provision for people and their livestock.

QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r18.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r18.claim: Matāʿ means a benefit for people and their livestock, meaning camels, cattle, and sheep.
QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r18.anchor: { متاعا لكم } أي منفعة لكم. { ولأنعامكم } من الإبل والبقر والغنم.

QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r19.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r19.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r19.claim: Matāʿan is an accusative verbal noun meaning ‘I provide enjoyment’; alternatively an omitted preposition means ‘for you to enjoy it.’
QURTUBI-FULL:79:31-33/r19.anchor: و «متاعا» نصب على المصدر من غير اللفظ لأن معنى «أخرج منها ماءها ومرعاها» أمتع بذلك

RAZI-FULL:v31p45#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#2/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#2/r8.claim: Rāzī takes the later statement that these are provision for people and livestock as evidence that pasture means everything eaten by both.
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#2/r8.anchor: يدل على أنه تعالى أراد بالمرعى كل ما يأكله الناس والأنعام

RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r2.claim: God made these things as enjoyment and benefit for people and their livestock.
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r2.anchor: والمعنى أنا إنما خلقنا هذه الأشياء متعة ومنفعة لكم ولأنعامكم

RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r3.speaker: من قال
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r3.claim: Those who argue that God’s acts and rulings are grounded in purposes and benefits cite this verse.
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r3.anchor: من قال : إن أفعال الله وأحكامه معللة بالأغراض والمصالح

RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r4.claim: Rāzī says the creation of heaven and earth establishes God’s ability to resurrect; after proving resurrection rationally, the passage announces that it will occur.
RAZI-FULL:v31p45#4/r4.anchor: ذكر كيفية خلقة السماء والأرض ليستدل بها على كونه قادرا على الحشر والنشر

STUDYQURAN:79:33/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:79:33/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:79:33/r1.claim: God sustains all things and makes them serve human beings, including by providing sustenance for people and their flocks.
STUDYQURAN:79:33/r1.anchor: God sustains all things and has made all things subservient to human beings

STUDYQURAN:79:33/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:79:33/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:79:33/r2.claim: As God's vicegerents, humans should thank Him for sustenance and share these resources with all creatures.
STUDYQURAN:79:33/r2.anchor: Human beings are thus God’s vicegerents (see, e.g., 2:30; 6:165c; 35:39)

ELMALILI:79:27-33/r22.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:79:27-33/r22.speaker: author
ELMALILI:79:27-33/r22.claim: Earth’s spreading makes its crust fit for life and habitation, providing benefit and sustenance for people and animals; this great act is purposeful rather than futile or accidental, and life has wisdom and an end.
ELMALILI:79:27-33/r22.anchor: bu büyük sun‘u kudret hikmetsiz değil, bunlar gayesiz abes olarak, keyfemettefak yaratılıvermemiştir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r1.claim: The vast, complex, ordered cosmos is evidence to resurrection deniers that its creator can raise people again; another verse says creating heaven and earth is greater than creating humanity.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r1.anchor: böylesine geniş ve kompleks olan, düzenli ve uyumlu işleyen varlıklar dünyasını yaratan kudretin insanları da öldükten sonra tekrar diriltebileceğine işaret edilmiştir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r4.claim: Making earth habitable and furnishing it with provisions for people and animals also demonstrates God's power to resurrect.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:79:27/r4.anchor: yeryüzünü üzerinde yaşanacak bir şekilde yaratıp gerek insanların gerekse hayvanların beslenmesi için her türlü nimetlerle donatması

QUSHAYRI:v3p389/r14.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p389/r14.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p389/r14.claim: The vegetation is provided for people and their livestock to enjoy.
QUSHAYRI:v3p389/r14.anchor: أي أخرجنا النبات ليكون لكم به استمتاع ، وكذلك لأنعامكم

ITQAN:v3p35/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p35/r3.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p35/r3.claim: Gabriel precedes Michael because he is superior, and rational beings precede other creatures in examples such as provision for people and livestock and glorification by birds.
ITQAN:v3p35/r3.anchor: وتقديم جبريل على ميكائيل في آية البقرة لأنه أفضل وتقديم العاقل على غيره

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p558/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p558/r6.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p558/r6.claim: A second sense is benefit; Ibn Qutayba explains the uninhabited houses as inns that shelter visitors from heat and cold.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p558/r6.anchor: والثاني : المنفعة . ومنه قوله تعالى في المائدة

FARRA:v3p232/r6.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p232/r6.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p232/r6.claim: The creation described was made as provision and enjoyment for you.
FARRA:v3p232/r6.anchor: خلق ذلك منفعة لكم، ومتعة لكم

FARRA:v3p232/r7.claim: The uninflected متاع لكم is also correct as a new clause with an omitted nominative element; he cites comparable Quranic wording.
FARRA:v3p232/r7.anchor: ولو كانت متاع لكم كان صوابا
